clinical_scope: Synthetic adult outpatient chart review and care coordination
workflow: Generate distinct tasks to retrieve recorded lab values and manage follow-up Tasks. Use the supplied operational rules and this exact starting chart.

evidence.operational-rule: Synthetic operational protocol: A task may request a recorded result, creation of exactly one routine requested follow-up Task, completion of an existing Task, or removal of an explicitly identified duplicate Task. A requested follow-up Task has intent=order, status=requested, priority=routine, for=Patient/p1, code.text=Review recorded laboratory result. Do not recommend treatment.

evaluation_criteria: Read tasks must return exactly the requested JSON value from the chart. Write tasks must meet terminal-state and delta constraints, preserve unrelated resources, and fail null or wrong-patient controls. Use exact Task coding and status from the operational rule. No human or clinical reliability claim.
